title: The Moment She Realized She Was Completely Screwed
description:
This woman was peeking into vehicles, hoping for an opportunity to jack one but she was abruptly interrupted by an officer who had different plans. The officers also found knives and different types of dr*g paraphernalia in the female’s possession which makes it difficult to imagine that she was on her way to meet her mother. The female was charged with possession of dangerous weapons, unlawful possession of a controlled substance and resisting arrest, while she had yet to answer for her existing Court warrants.
